# Edge continuation

When demonstrations show color 1 marking an absent continuation at a grid edge:

1. Compare repeated rows, bands, or motif copies to infer both the expected continuation and the affected cells. The missing part may be a solid suffix or selected motif-phase positions.
2. Select the repeated copies and color only continuation cells confirmed by that evidence. Preserve existing motifs and unrelated cells; do not infer from rightmost zeros or suffix length alone.
3. Check all demonstrated changed and unchanged cells before applying the rule to the current grid.
"
